experiments.name: Paid usability session cohort, 30 sessions
experiments.design: 30 paid sessions in 60 days from week 1: Upwork 15 from 3 posts, Fiverr 5, cold email 6, LinkedIn 4. $150 per session, optional $75 interview. Findings digest after each batch of 10.

experiments.name: App Store listing v1, Shopper Words Test first
experiments.design: Screenshots in the order Shopper Words Test, product cards, Analytics, plan page. Chat category. Measure listing visit to install for 30 days from go-live.

experiments.name: Founding cohort of 20 US stores
experiments.design: 20 stores, 50% off any paid plan for 6 billing periods, hands-on onboarding, a monthly 30-minute call. Store-level baseline: zero result rate on requests in days 1 to 30 against days 31 to 60.
experiments.budget_note: Revenue given up, not cash: about $2,940 if all 20 choose Growth, $5,940 if all choose Pro.

experiments.name: Shopify Store Findability Scorecard
experiments.design: Seven-question ScoreApp scorecard, three tiers, four emails. 70 to 100 routed to the founding cohort. Measure completions that open the sandbox.

experiments.name: Partner program launch
experiments.design: Partner page live in week 6 after counsel review. Invitations to session participants met by email and LinkedIn. Upwork and Fiverr participants find the page on their own.

experiments.name: Quota pause instead of overage
experiments.design: Ship alerts at 80% and 100%, 10% grace on paid plans, and the launcher pause. Tag every uninstall reason. Compare the share of uninstall reasons citing billing or the pause against the 20% line.
